title: SliMOO: Interpretable Multi-Objective Evolutionary Search for LLM Depth Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27812v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) grow more powerful, their scale makes them costly to serve. Depth pruning offers a practical route to efficiency by directly reducing memory and latency without hardware-specific support. However, we observe that transformer layers exhibit markedly different task-dependent layer contributions, whereas existing depth-pruning methods ignore this heterogeneity and thus tend to optimize for a narrow domain or benchmark rather than preserve broad capability. This suggests that LLM depth pruning should be formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem rather than a single-score ranking problem.   We propose SliMOO, an interpretable multi-objective evolutionary search framework for LLM depth pruning. SliMOO first uses single-layer removal probing to construct a task-layer importance map, which provides an interpretable view of task-shared and task-specific layers and serves as a search prior. translated_title: SliMOO：面向大语言模型深度剪枝的可解释多目标进化搜索
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的能力不断增强，其庞大的规模使得模型服务成本高昂。深度剪枝通过直接减少内存占用和推理延迟，且无需特定硬件支持，为提升效率提供了一条实用的途径。然而，我们观察到Transformer的各层表现出显著不同的任务相关性层级贡献，而现有的深度剪枝方法忽视了这种异质性，因此往往只针对狭窄的领域或基准进行优化，而无法保留模型广泛的能力。这表明LLM的深度剪枝应被表述为一个多目标优化问题，而非单分数排序问题。我们提出了SliMOO，一个用于LLM深度剪枝的可解释多目标进化搜索框架。SliMOO首先利用单层移除探测构建任务-层重要性图谱，该图谱提供了任务共享层与任务特定层的可解释视图，并作为搜索的先验信息，随后在此基础上执行……
tldr: SliMOO将LLM深度剪枝表述为多目标优化问题，通过单层移除探测构建可解释的任务-层重要性图谱，并结合多目标进化搜索，在压缩模型的同时保留跨任务的广泛能力。
en_tdlr: SliMOO formulates LLM depth pruning as a multi-objective optimization problem, using single-layer removal probing to build an interpretable task-layer importance map combined with multi-objective evolutionary search, thereby compressing models while preserving broad capabilities across tasks.
